entities.summary: Mårten Eskil Winge was a Swedish artist. He was a professor at the Royal Swedish Academy of Arts. He was associated with the Düsseldorf school of painting. His art was influenced by the Norse mythology themes also found in works by Nils Blommér (1816–1853) and Carl Wahlbom (1810-1858). Mårten Eskil Winge was a writers & intellectuals from Stockholm (1825-09-21, Stockholm–1896-04-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

entities.summary: Mårten Eskil Winge was a Swedish artist. He was a professor at the Royal Swedish Academy of Arts. He was associated with the Düsseldorf school of painting. His art was influenced by the Norse mythology themes also found in works by Nils Blommér (1816–1853) and Carl Wahlbom (1810-1858). Mårten Eskil Winge was a writers & intellectuals from Stockholm (1825-09-21, Stockholm–1896-04-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
